body.message:
Hi Fam Living Team,

We checked into the apartment today for our one-month stay and noticed that one of the beds has a large, unpleasant stain on the upholstered bed frame. It appears it wasn’t properly cleaned before our check-in.

Could you please arrange for your housekeeping team to come and professionally clean it as soon as possible? We’d appreciate having this resolved promptly so the apartment is in a clean and hygienic condition for our stay.

Thank you, and we look forward to your prompt assistance.
